definitions.explanation: A place other than here; elsewhere. Often implies somewhere unfamiliar or outside one's group.
People who are not part of one's own group or family.

examples.japanese: {余所|よそ}で{食事|しょくじ}しよう。
{余所|よそ}の{子|こ}と{比|くら}べてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't compare with other people's children.

examples.japanese: {余所|よそ}{見|み}をしないで{運転|うんてん}してください。
examples.english: Please don't look away while driving.

notes:
WRITING: Often written in hiragana as よそ. Also written as {他所|よそ}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{余所|よそ}{見|み} (looking away, getting distracted)
・{余所|よそ}{者|もの} (outsider, stranger)
・{余所|よそ}{行|い}き (going out, also: clothes for going out)
・{余所|よそ}の{人|ひと} (other people, strangers)

USAGE: Implies 'not here' or 'not us' - carries a sense of separation or unfamiliarity.
